# Podbean

> > Podbean is a comprehensive podcast hosting and monetization platform with AI-powered tools, enterprise solutions, and a mobile podcast player app.

Podbean provides end-to-end podcasting solutions including Podbean AI for audio enhancement, PodAds Marketplace for advertising, Fan Club subscriptions, live streaming, and Podbean Pro for enterprise customers with SOC 2 compliance. The platform integrates with Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube while offering developer APIs and a mobile podcast recorder app.

## Key Topics

- Podbean AI
- PodAds Marketplace
- Podcast monetization
- Podcast hosting
- Apple Podcasts Subscriptions
- Fan Club
- Podbean Pro (Enterprise)
- SOC 2 compliance
- Live streaming
- AI audio enhancement
- Podcast analytics
- Podcast advertising
- Christian podcasting
- Mobile podcast recorder
- Developer API

## Getting Started & Core Platform

- [Starting a podcast today with Podbean](https://www.podbean.com/start-podcast): Main onboarding page for starting podcasts with Podbean hosting tools

- [Free Podcast Audio Recording App | Podbean](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-recorder): Free podcast recording app with AI enhancement and cloud backup
- [The Best Podcast App | Podbean](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-app-iphone-android-mobile): Podbean mobile podcast player app with intelligent speed and playlists

## Enterprise & Professional Solutions

- [Private Podcast Hosting for Enterprises | Podbean Pro](https://www.podbean.com/site/startPodcast/privatePodcast): Podbean Pro enterprise solution with SOC 2 compliance and SSO support

## Apps & Integrations

- [Podcast plugins, podcast app market | Podbean](https://apps.podbean.com): App marketplace for Podbean AI, PodAds, and other podcast plugins
- [Podbean developer platform - Earn money by building for podcasts](https://developers.podbean.com): Developer platform with API for building podcast apps and integrations
